meta.name: Generate Image (MOSS-Image)
meta.licenseNote: MOSS-Image-SFT is Apache-2.0 (OpenMOSS, 2026-10); the ComfyUI repack Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image is Apache-2.0; its Qwen3.5-9B text encoder is Apache-2.0. The app ships no weights.
meta.notes: Runs natively (genai-native qir::moss) with a realism recipe after RaymondLuxuryYacht's MOSS realism workflow (Civitai 3035895): Qwen3.5-9B's last hidden state for the prompt in its chat template with thinking on, 20 res_2s steps (RES4LYF's two-stage exponential sampler with eta 0.5 noise) on the shift-5 schedule, plain CFG 3 against the negative ("blur, smooth, anime, render, cartoon, 3d" when none is typed), the FLUX.2 small decoder. Files from Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image (each may sit one subfolder deep) and Qwen3.5's tokenizer.json in text_encoders/qwen35_tokenizer/.
meta.creator: OpenMOSS
meta.description: Text to image with strong text rendering and layouts
